content.question: Match common clustering algorithms with their ideas.

answer.K-Means: It iteratively assigns data points to the nearest centroid and updates each centroid based on the mean of the data points within the cluster.
answer.Hierarchical clustering: It starts by treating each data point as a separate cluster, then iteratively merges the closest clusters based on a chosen distance metric.
answer.DBSCAN: It starts from a randomly selected point and expands the cluster by recursively adding neighbouring points, stopping when all points are assigned to a cluster or labeled as noise.
